text:
pagerbot: [ALERT] PagerDuty: `error_rate_high` fired for service `inference-gateway-hosted` (rule: http_5xx_rate > 3% over 1m). PD: INC-2026-884. Dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/alerts/INC-2026-884

pagerbot: Primary symptom: 5xx spike (502/504/500 mix). Current 1m 5xx = 5.8%, baseline ~0.2%. Affected region: eu-west1. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream.

alice: ack. I'm oncall. Pulling traces and gateway logs.

alice: quick checks: no infra deploys in last 30m, autoscaling events: none reported, Dedicated pool usage up but not saturated. Starting live tail on gw nodes.

jordan: seeing lots of 502 returned by proxy -> upstream hang/timeout to model workers. Example from gw-12: `upstream read timeout after 10s` followed by a 502. Also a handful of `KVCache OOM` entries on model-worker logs.

eng-oncall: @alice can you identify if it's a model runtime OOM vs network glitch? If OOM, we should flip to a lower-mem variant and scale Dedicated. If network, fail open to fallback region.

alice: running grep on model logs now, snippet: ```
2026-11-09T12:59:02Z model-worker[pid:2044]: ERROR decoder.cpp: KVCache reserve failed, requested=1.3GB, available=0.8GB
2026-11-09T12:59:03Z model-worker[pid:2044]: WARNING out-of-memory, rejecting request
2026-11-09T12:59:04Z proxy[gw-12]: upstream read timeout (10s) -> 502
```

sre-rotation: likely kernel-level memory pressure on certain worker instance types. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) enable smart-routing fallback to quantized variant `gptj-q4_0`, 2) add +2 GPUs to eu-west1 Dedicated pool, 3) temporarily increase upstream timeout to reduce 502 churn while scaling.

alice: executing mitigation 1 & 3 now. Command: `redwood route update --service=inference-gateway --region=eu-west1 --fallback=gptj-q4_0 --upstream-timeout=20s`

ops-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-884 acknowledged by alice at 1789456820. Escalation timer paused.

eng-oncall: making autoscale request to Dedicated: `dedicated scale --pool=eu-west1-inference --add-gpus=2 --priority=urgent` (ticket sent to capacity manager). ETA ~60-90s for nodes to register.

jordan: after route change, I'm seeing fewer OOM logs in model workers, and 5xx rate starting to drop (now 3.1%). p95 latency for /v1/generate decreased from 420ms -> 330ms.

cs-lead: Customer-facing note: multiple tenants in eu-west1 may see degraded throughput; we're failing to fallback model variants automatically for some clients. Working on a public status update draft.

alice: drafting status: "We detected elevated 5xx errors in eu-west1 affecting inference requests. We've applied a regional fallback to a lower-memory model variant and scaled capacity; we're monitoring. No customer data exposure."

alice: posting to status page now: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-884-draft

sre-rotation: 5xx trend: 1m window now 1.9% -> under alert threshold. Continue monitoring for 15m. Recommend ad-hoc canary of previous runtime image if errors persist.

eng-oncall: capacity nodes are healthy and registered. Confirmed +2 GPUs online at 1789457050.

jordan: confirming traffic shift: ~45% of requests in eu-west1 now routed to gptj-q4_0 fallback. Error rate on fallback = 0.1%. Good.

alice: handing off to next oncall in ~10m. @sre-rotation I'll leave the monitoring dashboard and PD on-call for escalation. Action items: (1) run memory profiler on failing worker image, (2) evaluate model quantization compatibility for hot routes, (3) add runbook step to auto-fallback when KVCache OOMs spike.

sre-rotation: ack. I'll pick up the post-incident and start a troubleshoot runbook doc. Will also open a Jira: INF-5472 (mem pressure root cause).

ops-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-884 resolved by alice at 1789457245 (status: mitigated).

alice: marking thread as resolved for now. Will follow up with a short postmortem in #postmortems and link to runbook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

jordan: quick note for PI: consider lowering default upstream request size for large-batched prompts — those seem to correlate with KVCache pressure.

cs-lead: I'll notify impacted accounts with the status update and mention mitigations applied.

pagerbot: Incident closed (mitigated). PD incident link: https://pagerduty/incidents/INC-2026-884. Postmortem owner: sre-rotation.
